placement.furniture_rule: Use empty floor space. Do not overlay a second existing post/chair/bench.

caveats: All three action poses remain new unapproved candidates.
Large source images have pixel-style clusters; this is not a fully hand-authored common native pixel grid. Engine derivatives use nearest-neighbor reduction.
Neoul retains a fairly large original-style striped tail; it was not slimmed down.
Props are baked into each action sprite and scale jointly with the body. Use empty floor space rather than overlaying a second existing post, chair, or bench.
Buri face and clothing were based on the original buri-0 artwork, not the unapproved front candidate. Head is turned toward the player but retains a three-quarter angle.
single_pose_rule: Do not infer or synthesize extra expression states from this one pose.

identity_reference.role: Existing design reference only; the Doto file is the user-selected v4 base. Not an additional new action state.

apply_rule: Keep the canonical speaker/runtime key. Update only the explicit action-pose asset binding; do not fabricate missing states.

profile_visibility.rule: Show only after the existing encounter/reveal state for this canonical runtime character is satisfied. Keep existing unknown/silhouette behavior before encounter.
